Hi Alex / Priya —

Great to meet earlier today. Thanks for the time and for walking through Sunridge’s primary goals for the pilot (latency-sensitive triage, PII handling, and integration with the EHR). Per our discussion, I’ve put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to make next steps and ownership explicit so we can keep momentum.

Quick recap (from the discovery):
- Success criteria: <10% degradation on current triage latency for 95th pct, accurate redaction of PHI, measurable throughput at expected peak loads.
- Pilot scope: 2 sites, anonymized historical data for evaluation, integrations with EHR via our ingestion pipeline.
- Stakeholders you mentioned: Alex (PM), Priya (Clinical ops), Sara (Security/CISO), Procurement and Legal as required.

Attached is a working MAP (Sunridge_MAP_v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones, owners, dates, and dependencies. High level milestones:
1) MAP kickoff & stakeholder confirm — owner: Sunridge / Redwood — target: week of 6/8
2) Security/compliance questionnaire + evidence exchange — owner: Sunridge / Redwood — target: 6/15–6/22
3) Environment & trial provisioning (test capacity + connectors) — owner: Redwood (SE/Infra) — target: 6/22–7/6
4) Pilot data ingestion & validation — owner: Sunridge (data team) / Redwood (SE) — target: 7/6–7/20
5) Pilot evaluation & adjustments — owner: joint — target: 7/20–7/27
6) PO/SOW & contract sign — owner: Sunridge Legal/Procurement + Redwood Sales — target: 7/30–8/5

Two timeline options included in the MAP:
- Option A (aggressive): 6–8 week timeline to pilot with target close by ~2026-07-30. Requires prioritized security review and procurement fast-track.
- Option B (conservative): 10–12 week timeline with more lead time for procurement and extended validation — target close ~2026-08-20.

Initial asks:
1) Please confirm the list of stakeholders who should be on the kickoff and who will own security/compliance responses (I flagged Sara as CISO).
2) Which timeline do you prefer (Option A or Option B)? If neither, suggest dates that reflect procurement lead times.
3) Any additional dependencies or internal approvals we should add (e.g., legal review windows, budget committee dates)?

I’m happy to run the kickoff. If helpful, we can schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff next week to walk the MAP and assign owners.

Links: HubSpot deal (attached) and MAP in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Axyz-Sunridge-MAP

Attachment: Sunridge_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft — milestones, responsibilities, dates)

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.
